limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

report_id.description: UUID of the report whose artefacts you're addressing. This must be a report id (the report's own UUID), not a signal id such as `sig_praise` — a non-report id returns 404.

type.description: Comma-separated artefact types to return, for example `signal_finding,note`. Omit it to return every type. `signal_finding` holds the evidence behind the report, `note` holds free-form notes such as the `## Verification plan`, and `task_run` records research and implementation runs. Values match the `type` of the returned artefacts. `count` and pagination cover only the matching artefacts. An unknown type returns 400 with the accepted values.
